modes.effect: Delayed cracking, catastrophic brittle fracture under load
modes.cause: Co-deposited hydrogen during high-HER plating conditions
modes.mitigation: Post-deposition bake (200°C/4h), low-CE plating window avoidance, hydrogen permeation monitoring

modes.effect: Non-uniform carbon distribution, weak spots, poor wear resistance
modes.cause: Inadequate particle suspension, settling in quiescent zones
modes.mitigation: Ultrasonic agitation, surfactant dispersants, pulsed flow to prevent settling

modes.effect: Part rejection, catastrophic failure in service
modes.cause: Excessive thermal stress during rapid quench, sharp geometry features
modes.mitigation: Interrupted quench (martempering), generous fillet radii in design, UT inspection post-quench

modes.effect: Gradual quality degradation not caught by pass/fail checks
modes.cause: Slow process parameter drift, bath aging, equipment wear
modes.mitigation: SPC trend analysis with Western Electric rules, campaign-level Cpk tracking, periodic re-validation

modes.effect: Unexpected Ni/Fe ratio shift, inconsistent alloy composition
modes.cause: Hydroxide suppression mechanism instability at boundary layer
modes.mitigation: Real-time ICP-OES at cathode boundary, controlled mass transport (rotating cylinder electrode)

modes.effect: Inclusions in deposit, poor surface finish, reduced ductility
modes.cause: Dissolved Cr, Cu, Zn from auxiliary equipment or anode corrosion
modes.mitigation: Continuous electrolyte purification (ion exchange), anode material selection, regular ICP-OES monitoring

modes.effect: Reduced faradaic efficiency, hydrogen porosity in deposit
modes.cause: High overpotential, low pH, catalytic cathode surface
modes.mitigation: pH control (3.0–3.5), pulse plating to limit peak overpotential, HER-inhibiting surfactants

modes.effect: Increased cell voltage, reduced throughput, electrolyte crossover
modes.cause: Fe(OH)₃ precipitation, CaSO₄ scaling, organic/biofilm growth on cation-exchange membrane
modes.mitigation: Periodic acid wash cycle, electrolyte pre-filtration, anti-fouling membrane coating

modes.effect: Brittle deposits, crack initiation sites, fatigue life reduction
modes.cause: Organic breakdown products, colloidal impurities co-depositing with metal
modes.mitigation: Electrolyte filtration (<1 µm), activated carbon treatment, periodic bath replacement

modes.effect: Anisotropic mechanical properties, weak transverse direction
modes.cause: High current density without pulse reversal, limited nucleation sites
modes.mitigation: Pulse plating with reverse pulse, grain refiner addition, current density optimization

modes.effect: Dimensional instability, soft spots, transformation-induced cracking
modes.cause: High carbon/nickel content shifting Ms below room temperature
modes.mitigation: Sub-zero treatment (-80°C), double temper, XRD retained austenite monitoring

modes.effect: Systematic error in Ni/C content, incorrect mechanical property prediction
modes.cause: Non-uniform deposit composition, single-point ICP-OES sampling
modes.mitigation: Multi-point sampling grid, cross-section line scan, statistical process control

modes.effect: Increased cell voltage, contamination, process instability
modes.cause: Oxidative dissolution of DSA or Pb-based anode at high current density
modes.mitigation: DSA coating with IrO₂/TiO₂, voltage monitoring with automated anode replacement alerts

modes.effect: Out-of-tolerance dimensions, machining allowance exceeded
modes.cause: Non-uniform heating/cooling, gravity sag in furnace, asymmetric geometry
modes.mitigation: Fixture-based quenching, symmetric racking, CFD-optimized furnace flow

modes.effect: Reduced yield strength (Hall-Petch), loss of nanostructure benefits
modes.cause: Thermal excursion during post-deposition handling or slow cooling
modes.mitigation: EBSD monitoring, controlled cooling rate specification, thermal budget tracking

modes.effect: Soft surface layer, reduced wear/case hardening effectiveness
modes.cause: Oxygen ingress in furnace, insufficient carburizing atmosphere control
modes.mitigation: Endo-gas atmosphere control, oxygen probe monitoring, anti-scale coating for non-carburized surfaces

modes.effect: Precipitation of Fe(OH)₃, bath destabilization, deposit defects
modes.cause: Buffer exhaustion at high throughput, acid consumption exceeding replenishment
modes.mitigation: Automated pH dosing system with redundant sensors, buffer capacity monitoring

modes.effect: Gas evolution, additive depletion, deposit quality degradation
modes.cause: Electrolytic breakdown of organic additives at high overpotential
modes.mitigation: Additive concentration monitoring (CVSA), replenishment dosing system, current density limits

modes.effect: Layered deposit with weak interlayer bonds, delamination risk
modes.cause: Power supply failure, contact resistance drift, anode short circuit
modes.mitigation: UPS backup, contact resistance monitoring with auto-shutdown, redundant rectifiers

modes.effect: Accelerated side reactions, changed kinetics, bath instability
modes.cause: Joule heating at high current, cooling system failure, ambient variation
modes.mitigation: PID temperature control with redundant TC, heat exchanger sizing, alarm interlocks

modes.effect: False accept/reject, incorrect tempering parameter adjustment
modes.cause: Indenter wear, surface roughness, insufficient test load for thin layers
modes.mitigation: Indenter calibration schedule, surface preparation SOP, micro-hardness for thin layers

modes.effect: Surface scale, dimensional change, post-treatment grinding required
modes.cause: Furnace atmosphere breach, quench medium contamination
modes.mitigation: Vacuum or inert gas quenching, sealed furnace design, atmosphere dew point monitoring
